summary: Frontend-only validation completed for Home Firestore synchronization. Home now renders live Firestore lessons/plans (2 lesson cards, 1 plan card observed) instead of static fallback content, and production build succeeds. However, contact enquiry preselection from Home cards is broken for live document names.

integration_issues.flow: Home lesson card -> Contact enquiry preselection
integration_issues.issue: URL includes ?lesson=<live_name> correctly, but contact select defaults to 'Automatic' instead of the clicked live lesson name (reproduced with lesson '#1twst').

integration_issues.flow: Home plan card -> Contact enquiry preselection
integration_issues.issue: URL includes ?plan=<live_name> correctly, but contact select defaults to 'Automatic' instead of the clicked live plan name (reproduced with plan 'Test').
Console shows Firestore permissions warning: '[firestore] subscribe failed ratings Missing or insufficient permissions.' during page load.

action_items: Update Contact form options to include live Firestore lessons/plans (or handle unknown query values) so selectedPlan preserves clicked Home lesson/plan names.
Keep Home->Contact query link behavior as-is (already correct URL param construction).
If rating cards are intended public, align Firestore rules/queries to avoid permission warnings on Home.
critical_code_review_comments: Home correctly subscribes to Firestore lessons/plans and falls back only when live arrays are empty.
Contact prefill relies on static LESSONS/PLANS option lists, which causes value mismatch when Home uses live Firestore names not present in static arrays.
This mismatch is the root cause of failed preselection despite correct query parameter routing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduced on public URL from frontend/.env. Home live sync works (2 live lessons, 1 live plan displayed). Regression remains in Contact preselection for live names; select falls back to 'Automatic'. Build passes with `yarn build`.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: click first live lesson/plan card on Home, verify URL contains lesson/plan query, then inspect `[data-testid='contact-plan-select']` value. Observed value is 'Automatic' instead of clicked live name. Root cause: Contact select options are generated from static LESSONS/PLANS constants; live Firestore names from Home are absent from option list, so controlled select cannot represent query value and reverts to default option. Mitigation: source contact selectable options from same live Firestore collections (with fallback) or inject query value as temporary option when absent.
